text:
ashley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: recurring evening surge + autoscaler instability. We need concrete owners for remediation tickets.

noah: I'll own the autoscaler cooldowns and smoothing. Plan: increase cooldowns from 60s -> 180s and implement a rate limiter to prevent scale-down thrash. ETA next Tue.

reza: I'll take quota smoothing / backstop. Idea: add a moving-average-based soft quota that prevents sudden reserve exhaustion from bursts. Also add a weekly 'low headroom' alarm to catch slow degradation. ETA: EOW.

ashley: thanks. eng-platform, can you scope the API changes for exposing per-pool desired_headroom_pct? ops console needs it for the new dashboard.

eng-platform: noted. API change is small (add desired_headroom_pct to /pools). I'll open a PR and aim to merge by Fri.

noah: for testing autoscaler changes I'll run chaos tests with node-preempt events to reproduce thrash. Test harness snippet: 

```
# chaos test
inject_preempt(node_group='spot', count=2, interval=30s)
measure(scale_events, tail_latency)
```

reza: acceptance criteria for quota smoothing: sustained QPS spike should not trigger paging if moving average stays below 90% for 10m. If >95% sustained then page.

ops-bot: Logged remediation items: R-3401 (autoscaler cooldowns), R-3402 (quota smoothing), R-3403 (headroom API + dashboard).

ashley: ownership recap: noah -> R-3401 (cooldowns & chaos tests, due 2024-07-16), reza -> R-3402 (quota smoothing + alerting, due 2024-07-12), eng-platform -> R-3403 (API + dashboard hookup, due 2024-07-14). I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups section.

noah: small note: scheduler bin-packing still shows a pattern where small background jobs monopolize GPU mem under certain mix. I'll open a probe ticket to collect per-job mem_frac histograms.

reza: good call. that data will help tune eviction priorities. Also propose a temp policy: pin interactive pools with headroom + highest eviction_priority so they avoid being packed with heavy batch jobs.

eng-platform: the ops console can show a "predicted runway" column using a 1-hr linear forecast. We'll wire model output later.

ashley: let's also create a recurring checklist item in incident review: "check weekly headroom trend" assigned to SRE on Monday mornings. Reduces surprise regressions.

ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem updated with follow-ups: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1743011122.

noah: blocker: need temporary access to the test cluster GPU metrics for chaos runs. @infra-sre can you help grant?

reza: I'll prepare the acceptance test harness and add the test cases to CI.

ashley: sounds good. we'll reconvene in 2 business days to review progress. thanks all :white_check_mark:
